statement: theorem one_step (V : Domain (E := E)) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (t : ℕ) (hη : 0 < η t) (hloss : BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.SubdifferentiableOn V (loss t)) (hg : selected V η loss x₁ p t ∈ SourceSubdifferential (loss t) (output V η loss x₁ p t)) (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) : (loss t (output V η loss x₁ p t)).toReal - (loss t u).toReal ≤ (‖output V η loss x₁ p t - u‖ ^ 2 - ‖output V η loss x₁ p (t + 1) - u‖ ^ 2) / (2 * η t) + η t / 2 * ‖selected V η loss x₁ p t‖ ^ 2
source_assumptions: (hg : selected V η loss x₁ p t ∈ SourceSubdifferential (loss t) (output V η loss x₁ p t))
